atif_metni: Center for Advanced Spatial Technologies, University of Arkansas/U.S. Geological Survey
not: The template is incomplete in the report (it is cut off with an ellipsis at the end) and cannot be called without knowing the frame ID. Coverage of Hasankeyf (41.41 E; 37.71 N) could not be verified: a GetFeatureInfo request at that point or a bbox scan in the GWC capabilities is needed. The report gives the address with http; GitHub Pages uses https, so the https version should be tried, otherwise it runs into the mixed-content block. CORS is not documented. Server continuity is weak, WFS is often offline. Recommendation: download the Hasankeyf frames as NITF, convert them to a COG or PMTiles file of our own and host it on GitHub. Coverage counters: 279 missions, 2,214 images, 833 archaeological sites.

ad: Esri Wayback metaveri servisi (gerçek çekim tarihi)
katman_kimligi: Ölçeğe bağlı katmanlar; alanlar SRC_DATE, SRC_RES, SRC_ACC, SRC_DESC, NICE_NAME, MinMapLevel, MaxMapLevel. Örnek servis adı World_Imagery_Metadata_2023_r11
not: Not a tile layer, but a query service. Example query: .../MapServer/{layerId}/query?geometry=41.41,37.71&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&outFields=*&f=json . The most practical route is getMetadata(point, zoom, releaseNumber) in the open-source @esri/wayback-core library. Warning: according to the Esri forum, metadata for older releases may be inconsistent and is not updated. A pop-up showing SRC_DATE on click is recommended for the atlas.
